desc: If you are the kind of turkey hunter that lives for springtime and practices your mouth calls while driving to work in the winter, then a Super X Pump Long Beard is for you. The synthetic pistol grip stock with textured gripping surfaces gives your hands a sure, non-slip grip and the Mossy Oak Break-Up Country camo finish won't spook wary birds. To keep you on target, the Long Beard comes with two user-interchangeable combs and height adjust spacers that let you change the comb height for perfect eye-to-sight alignment with your choice of sighting systems. Two interchangeable LOP spacers allow you to fine-tune the length-of-pull for a perfect stock fit. With TruGlo fiber-optic sights included, you can aim with rifle-like precision. And since the Long Beard is drilled and tapped, you can use the optic of your choice.
